name: Moth
source:
Moth is an FBX employee that helps the Interloper repair and log the contents of the corrucyst.

They mostly deal with obesk-human relations, corrucystic technology and "a little culture here and there". 

[Based on [url=https://corru.wiki/wiki/Moth]Corru Observer Wiki[/url]]
